title: helm-os config
description: Your configuration. Supplies every user-specific value the framework reads (schedule, connectors, projects, voice). Lives in your vault as os.config.json; the framework repo ships none of it.

name.description: The principal the OS works for.

role.description: Job/role; steers the routine preset and vocabulary.

timezone.description: IANA tz, e.g. Asia/Manila. The clock stage reads this.

briefAddressee.description: Who the brief is written to (usually the principal).

slots.description: Hour (local, 0-23 as string) to mode. Modes: morning, capture, evening.

cron.description: Cron the adapter registers the routine with.

vaultRoot.description: Absolute path to the user's vault. The only absolute path; everything else is resolved relative to it by helm/lib/paths.js.

profile.description: Vault-relative path to the voice profile (default Personal/profile.md).

connectors.description: Which tools this user has. Absent connectors are simply skipped by the sweeps.

type.description: telegram | whatsapp | discord | slack | teams | gchat | imessage

identityIds.description: The user's own ids per connector, used to tell self from others (e.g. Discord authorId/guildId).

projects.description: The project-map. Each row is a project/mission the generic project-runner and portfolio-health drive.

floor.description: Weekdays of silence before a sweep fires anyway. Overrides the state default.

channels.description: Surfaces the project owns; free text or connector refs.

ledgerTag.description: Source tag written into the shared follow-ups ledger.

bespoke.description: Optional path to a file project that overrides the generic runner.

agentType.description: Optional: a harness subagent type to run this project instead of the generic runner (preserves a hand-tuned project agent).

areas.description: Brief taxonomy: how work is grouped and labeled in the composed brief.

careRanking.description: Priority hierarchy the audio brief weights by, most important first.

ledgerEnforce.description: false = write-ledger shadow mode, true = block duplicates.

audio.description: Audio brief. Needs a Gemini API key in your environment (GEMINI_TTS_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY); the OS never takes the key value, only reads it from the environment.

voice.description: Gemini TTS voice (male: Charon, Puck, Fenrir, Enceladus).

playerArtifactUrl.description: Standing player URL to republish in place; leave empty to mint a new one each run.

writes.description: How the OS writes to external systems. Email and chat are always draft-only. This controls trackers.

tracker.description: draft (default): the OS drafts proposed ticket comments/creates into the project's drafts/ for you to apply. auto: it writes them directly in your voice, gated by the write-ledger.
